assumptions.statement: 720m discussion buffer around generalized corridor, plus650m Xuebei buffer; key-area circles720/600/500m; candidate service envelopes30m
assumptions.impact: V4 participant model aligned to real anchors. 13.333242 km² is not the official 11.4 km² scope. Recompute all outputs after official data.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official or user-cleared site and key-area polygons with CRS and provenance.

assumptions.statement: August2026 statutory background is public, but precise competition vector boundaries and verified parcel-specific controls are not supplied.
assumptions.impact: No statutory intensity or parcel-level DRR conclusion is made.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Approved regulatory planning conditions and parcel data.

assumptions.statement: Existing buildings, ownership, occupancy, structural condition and heritage value are not fully surveyed.
assumptions.impact: 476 mapped existing building footprints, not six invented building prototypes. Access, height, ownership, structure and demolition decisions remain unverified.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Cleared existing-condition survey and ownership data.

assumptions.statement: Traffic counts, transit entrances, utilities, flood, fire and energy capacity are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Mobility and infrastructure lines express connectivity and service logic, not engineering alignments or capacity commitments.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official traffic, municipal, flood and fire-control data.

assumptions.statement: Exact heritage and landscape control boundaries are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Cultural installations and public-space components require heritage review before siting.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official heritage inventories and protection/control lines.

assumptions.statement: Events, taskboard governance and scenario operations are proposed mechanisms rather than confirmed government programmes.
assumptions.impact: Dates, operators, budgets, safety plans and rights terms require separate approval.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Named operating body, public consultation and approved event/safety plan.

assumptions.statement: OSM buildings, paths and greens are incomplete mapped subsets. Public circles30m represent candidate service envelopes only.
assumptions.impact: Ratios describe the model, not statutory indicators or actual public-space provision.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Field survey and official land/access records.

assumptions.statement: Photographs range from2021 to2025 and are clearly dated. No licensed recent Xuebei site photograph has been verified.
assumptions.impact: Use maps for Xuebei and repeat site photography before implementation.

assumptions.statement: 90days,20+questions,10teams,3prototypes and1archive are proposed targets, not completed results or government commitments.
assumptions.impact: Start only after site, resources and responsible people are secured.

assumptions.statement: Eleven site-linked AI-assisted scenes show design intent and are not existing-condition photographs or approved works. Every rendered use carries a prominent bilingual status label.
assumptions.impact: Heritage, access, safety, engineering and operational feasibility require field and professional review before any implementation.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Current site survey, stakeholder consent, heritage review and approved technical design.
